description: The plot illustrates how Accuracy@1 (in percent) varies with the number of child nodes (tree width) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale with values shown at 1, 3, 5, and 7 (tick interval 2). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly from 15 to 35, with evenly spaced tick marks at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35 (interval 5). The GPT-4o series is drawn as a solid line with circular markers; it starts at 24.4 at x=1, rises to 28.9 at x=3, increases further to a peak of 34.4 at x=5, then declines to 31.1 at x=7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet series is drawn as a solid line with “x” markers; it starts at 26.7 at x=1, increases to 27.8 at x=3, then decreases to 24.4 at x=5 and continues downward to 20.0 at x=7.
